ml_demo.code:
import torch, torch.nn as nn, numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import make_moons
torch.manual_seed(0)
X, y = make_moons(300, noise=0.2, random_state=0)
Xt = torch.tensor(X, dtype=torch.float32); yt = torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.float32).view(-1,1)
net = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2,16), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(16,1))
opt = torch.optim.SGD(net.parameters(), 0.1); lf = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss()
losses = []
for _ in range(300):
    opt.zero_grad(); loss = lf(net(Xt), yt); loss.backward(); opt.step(); losses.append(loss.item())
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6,6.5))
ax.plot(losses, color=CYAN, lw=3.5)
ax.fill_between(range(len(losses)), losses, color=CYAN, alpha=0.15)
ax.set_title('la pérdida BAJA en cada paso')
ax.set_xlabel('pasos'); ax.set_ylabel('error'); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
